title: D4543-6

page_data.en:

CONFIDENTIAL.
(Instructional)

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
**〔此处转录不清〕**

Headquarters Crime Branch.
June 6, 1933.

D.D.O.s             Memo No. 16/33.
Supt.i/c C.I.       Illegal Functioning
Senior Detec-       Political Cases.
tives.

Chinese authorities have recently been acting
illegally in making political arrests in the Settlement.
Owing to subsequent disclosures other methods may now be
employed.
It is possible wanted persons may be charged on
fictitious criminal charges and their handing over be
requested, the real reasons being political.
Co-operation with the Chinese authorities in
criminal cases is so important that an obstructive policy
is to be avoided, on the other hand where the evidence is
weak and ulterior motive may be suspected, Special Branch
should be informed as in ordinary political cases when accused
are bona fide residents of the Settlement.
It will then be a question whether a writ of
detention before handing over will be requested or not.
When there is doubt as to action advisable D.D.O.s
will put all the facts before D.C. (Cr) together with the
views of the Special Branch.
In important criminal cases kidnapping and robbery,
etc. should handing over be temporarily opposed, and a writ
of detention be taken out, the period of opposition should be
as short as possible and be immediately terminated if good
evidence of crime is subsequently produced. In such cases
facilities for members of the Public Safety Bureau to
interrogate detained men at Stations will always be given.
In a general way in crime cases handing over will
be carried out expeditiously as at present, but the possibility
of false accusation will be kept in view in each case.

Sgd. K.M. Bourne
Deputy Commissioner
(Crime Branch).

副本。

机密。
（指示性）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案室
**〔此处转录不清〕**

总部刑事科。
1933年6月6日。

副总督察               备忘录第16/33号。
政治处主管警司         非法运作
高级侦探               政治案件。

中国当局最近在租界内进行政治逮捕，此举属非法行为。鉴于随后的披露，今后可能会采用其他手段。
有可能通缉犯会被以虚构的刑事罪名起诉，并请求将其引渡，而真实原因则是政治性的。
在刑事案件中与中国当局的合作至关重要，因此应避免采取阻碍性政策；但另一方面，如果证据薄弱且怀疑有 ulterior motive（潜在动机/不可告人的目的），则应像处理普通政治案件那样通知政治处，特别是当被告确系租界居民时。
届时，问题将在于是否在引渡前申请拘留令。
当对应采取的行动存有疑虑时，副总督察应将所有事实以及政治处的意见一并呈报给刑事副处长（D.C. (Cr)）。
在绑架、抢劫等重大刑事案件中，如果暂时反对引渡并申请了拘留令，反对期限应尽可能短，并且如果随后提供了确凿的犯罪证据，应立即终止反对。在此类案件中，将始终为公共安全局成员在警局讯问被拘留者提供便利。
一般而言，刑事案件的引渡将如目前一样迅速执行，但在每个案件中都会考虑到诬告的可能性。

签名：K.M. Bourne
副总监
（刑事科）
